title: Jesus... They Want Me To Sign Something That Isn't True
topic: pressure to falsify a report at work

bible.text: No temptation has overtaken you except what is common to mankind. And God is faithful; he will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear. But when you are tempted, he will also provide a way out so that you can endure it.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... my manager asked me to sign a report. The numbers in it are not true.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: He said everyone signs it. Nobody checks. My name on it is just a formality.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: And you have been standing there an hour holding a pen you have not used.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I have rent. My sister's fees. I cannot afford to be the honest one.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Honesty is never something you afford. It is something you pay for.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: There is always a door out of the room. Rarely the loud one. But it is there, and you will not be pushed past what you can carry.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Have you ever been asked to stay quiet about something wrong? Ask the question before you sign. 🤍
